findings.claim: phase8SameEntries sorts each event's hook list, so the repair check at the changed call site no longer notices a duplicated entry's position or a reordered list. It still catches a missing entry, an extra entry, or a changed value, because the sorted keys keep duplicates and every other key in the document is compared. The weakening is deliberate and documented in the helper comment: a repaired entry is re-appended at the end of its list. The loss of order checking is limited to this one assertion. Optionally, if hook order matters at runtime, assert that the repaired list differs from the original only by the position of the repaired entry.
